Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
  • Class
    Description
    FederatedLogin
    The account a sign-in with an external provider resolved to.
    FederatedLoginOutcome
    How a sign-in with an external provider found its account.
    LinkIdentityUseCase
    Use case that links an identity of an external provider to the account of a signed-in user.
    ListIdentitiesUseCase
    Use case that lists the identities of external providers linked to an account.
    LockSignInMethodsUseCase
    Use case that locks the sign-in methods of an account for the rest of the caller's transaction and counts them: a password its owner knows (not a generated one), the linked identities, a passkey and the bound certificates.
    ResolveFederatedLoginUseCase
    Use case that resolves a sign-in with an external provider to a local account.
    SocialConfiguration
    Exposes the domain's FederatedLinkingPolicy as a bean, so the use cases of social login depend on the policy instead of creating it, and a deployment can replace it with a policy of its own.
    UnlinkIdentityUseCase
    Use case that unlinks an identity of an external provider from an account and audits it.
